ui.termsDesc: Ordering, delivery and privacy terms for the Sarfati smoked fish website.
ui.termsHebrew: The binding terms of use and privacy policy are published in Hebrew. Below is a summary of how ordering works.
ui.termsOrder:
Orders through the website: choosing products on the site and sending your order (by WhatsApp or a form) is an order request only. The order is final once a Sarfati representative has confirmed with you, by phone or in writing, availability, final weight, delivery date and price, and payment has been made.

Products sold by weight are charged by actual weight. Minimum order for delivery {min}, delivery fee {fee}, free delivery over {free}.

Cancellations follow the Israeli Consumer Protection Law; perishable food cannot be returned after delivery.

Privacy: we use the details you send us only to handle your order or enquiry and, if you joined the customer club, to send you offers. We do not sell your details to third parties. To update or delete your details, contact us at {email}.

all: All of Sarfati in one place – smoked salmon and fish, fish salads, platters, fresh and frozen fish. Chilled delivery to your door.
smoked: Salmon, tuna, halibut, trout and herring – smoked by hand over real wood at our boutique smokehouse in Shilat.
cold: Cold smoking at a low temperature keeps the texture silky and the smoky flavour delicate. The classic choice for bagels, platters and the Shabbat table.
hot: Hot smoking cooks the fish as it smokes, giving it a flaky, juicy texture and a deep flavour. Perfect as a main course, in a salad or cold as a starter.
salads: Smoked fish salads, pickled herring and matjes – ready to serve, just like in the old-style delis.
platters: Beautifully arranged platters for Shabbat, holidays, celebrations and business meetings. Ready to serve and delivered chilled.
frozen: Salmon fillet, red tuna, halibut, hake and fish burgers – frozen at peak freshness, ready in your freezer for any meal.
fresh: Sea bass, sea bream, fillets and steaks – carefully selected fish for cooking at home.
premium: Cantabrian anchovies, tuna in olive oil, cod roe spread and deli boxes – delicacies we picked especially for you.
gifts: Gourmet gift boxes for holidays, staff and clients – smoked salmon, wine and delicacies in one box.
drinks: Gilad wines and arak-based cocktails that go perfectly with our fish. Alcohol is sold to customers aged 18 and over only.
